selected_work: R86 deterministic hosted semantic smoke for R84/R85 fixed-function HLSL generation and non-routing compilation.
summary: Added a dedicated Win32 semantic smoke executable and Backend Conversion Gate steps. The smoke validates three supported fixed-function cases—diffuse passthrough, single-stage texture MODULATE, and two-stage CURRENT chaining—by checking deterministic generated HLSL expressions and requiring successful D3DCompile ps_4_0 bytecode. It also validates fail-closed behavior for a missing exact texture resource and an unsupported cube texture type. No game shader object is created or bound and native routing remains disabled.
evidence: CONVERSION-DX11-00028 completed R85 compiler-call integration but hosted CI did not yet execute deterministic generated HLSL cases.

changes.result: Added deterministic supported/fail-closed fixed-function HLSL cases with actual non-routing D3DCompile assertions.
Added dx11_fixed_function_shader_semantics executable as the cmkr source-of-truth target.

supported: SELECTARG1 DIFFUSE color/alpha passthrough with no texture declarations
single-stage TEXTURE * DIFFUSE MODULATE plus texture alpha
two-stage CURRENT * TEXTURE chaining using stage-1 texcoord
fail_closed: texture-consuming stage with present resource but missing exact resource bit
texture-consuming stage backed by D3DRTYPE_CUBETEXTURE instead of supported 2D D3DRTYPE_TEXTURE

activation_gate.reason: R86 validates only selected offline fixed-function source semantics and compiler acceptance. D3D9 visual equivalence, GPU execution, shader binding, live mirror ownership, programmable F21 translation and exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity remain unproven.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false. A later bounded DX11 task may broaden deterministic semantic coverage within the already-supported F20 subset or consume real R85 runtime census compiler evidence. Do not mix this with F21 programmable shader translation or native D3D11 shader binding.
